development team.

PROJECT
Route Bridge Logistics — Multi-Tenant Logistics Platform
Developing a platform where multiple merchants can register their shops, manage their businesses, and
serve customers through a unified system. The platform connects merchants, customers, and delivery
riders to streamline the shopping and delivery process, from order placement to successful delivery. It is
designed to support coordinated order management, delivery assignments, and delivery status tracking.
Technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Python, FastAPI, SQLModel, PostgreSQL,
Docker.
   Developing responsive user interfaces to support different platform user roles.
   Building backend APIs with Python and FastAPI and working with PostgreSQL for relational data
   management.
   Implementing role-based access control to manage permissions for different user roles.
   Organising application components and backend services using a modular development approach.
   Exploring delivery lifecycle management, order verification, notifications, and delivery status tracking.
VoxPlay — Social Gaming Platform
Developing a social gaming platform designed to bring players together through interactive multiplayer
games. Its first game, Brain Clash, focuses on timed challenges, trivia, riddles, word games, and friendly
competition.
   Designing an interactive gaming experience with a focus on responsive interfaces and player
   engagement.
   Planning multiplayer game modes that support voice- and text-based interaction.
   Structuring the platform to accommodate multiple game modes and future features.
